description: This file defines the EmailConfigurationService class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for accessing email configuration data and email services, including a function to send test emails.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationService
classes.description: Provides services for email configuration management, including retrieving DAOs and sending test emails.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationDao
methods.description: Retrieves the EmailConfigurationDao instance, creating it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Retrieves the EmailService instance, instantiating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: setEmailService
methods.description: Sets the EmailService instance for this service.

methods.name: sendTestMail
methods.description: Sends a test email using the EmailService.
